title: audio
description: Audio generation workflows and their limits (docs/design/CONFIG_HOMES.md, C8b). The stable names are in model_aliases; `aliases` keeps the older exact names. The workflow directory is a startup setting.

default_workflow.description: Workflow an audio request runs when it names no model.

aliases.description: Older exact names of a workflow, lower-case, each naming a workflow id. The stable names are in model_aliases and win on a clash.

additionalProperties.description: One audio workflow: the graph file and the length limits it was built for. Replaced whole by an owner edit.

file.description: Graph file, relative to the install or absolute.

normalize_peak_db.description: Peak level, in dB, the output is normalised to.
